namedPlots.coverageNote: BIVB lists Montrachet as the Grand Cru across Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet. The cadastre names its two principal areas MONTRACHET and LE MONTRACHET. These cadastral names are audited without asserting separate official climats or producer holdings. The cru name is also a constituent name, so displayLayer remains false and every white Montrachet wine retains the whole INAO outline across the commune line.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The 243.347030 m² remainder (0.304638%) was inspected in EPSG:2154 against the unmodified pinned INAO and cadastral polygons. All five components touch the INAO boundary. The largest follows the northern edge; the second and fourth follow the southwest boundary; the third is a narrow gap between the two communes (maximum enclosing-rectangle width 0.596 m); the fifth is a 0.107 m² eastern edge sliver. No missing commune or detached interior parcel was found. The 243.4 m² cap is less than 0.053 m² above the measurement. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled; changed hashes require a new review.
